run_description: Authoritative reproduction. Tracing disabled (no Langfuse key on this host), so prompt resolution is local and no network call is inside the measured window.
notes: Server-side P95 2652 ms is 652 ms above the released 2000 ms threshold; all 5 official requests breached it.
Error rate is 0% and quality_avg stays 0.86, so the symptom is isolated latency degradation, not a correctness or availability failure.
Client-side latency (11.0-13.7 s) is far above server-side latency (2651-2652 ms) because the blocking retrieval serialises the 5 concurrent requests. The gap is queueing time, not request work.

fix_verification.result: Same official workload with rag_slow disabled: P95 2652 ms -> 151 ms (back under the 2000 ms threshold), client-side 13.7 s -> 1.18 s.
